lines.text: Before you count the team, Atomy's U S plan has a personal P V gate.
It says you must first accumulate ten thousand personal P V before generating any downline P V.
That is an entry condition, not an automatic payday. Other qualification and commission rules still apply.
Think gate open, not money guaranteed. Read your local plan before buying for a threshold. Save the distinction.
